029624:             {
029625:                 IrTypeId base_type = builder->function->values[base.value].canonical_type;
029626:                 base = c_ir_emit_arrow_operand_from_place(builder, base, base_type, field_source);
029627:             }

029629:         }

029631:         {

029633:             return false;

029636:         state->type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type;

029641:     }
029642:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && start + 2 == end &&
029643:         (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ||
029644:          c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS)))
029645:     {
029646:         CToken update = builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1];
029647:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, start));
029648:         if (!local)
029649:         {
029650:             // Global objects use the general expression-core update path,
029651:             // which resolves their identifier to a global place before
029652:             // applying the increment.  Keep this local fast path narrow so
029653:             // a direct statement such as `listing++` is not rejected merely
029654:             // because it has no CIntegerIrLocal entry.
029655:             return c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_request_expression(builder, frame, state, C_IR_LOWER_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT_EXPRESSION, start, end);

029658:         bool success = c_ir_emit_compound_assignment(builder, local->place, local->type,
029659:                                                       c_token_is_punctuator(&update, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) ? C_CONDITIONAL_ADD : C_CONDITIONAL_SUBTRACT, one,
029660:                                                       c_ir_token_source_range(builder, update), 0, 0);
029661:         c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
029662:         return false;
029663:     }
029664:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&first, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_MINUS))
029665:     {
029666:         if (start + 2 != end || builder->preprocess.tokens[start + 1].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
029667:         {
029668:             // Prefix updates over a dereference (for example ++(*input)) are
029669:             // full expressions rather than the identifier fast path below.
029670:             // Let the expression machine form the dereferenced place and

029676:         if (!local)
029677:         {

029679:             // how to form a place for a global identifier, so let it handle

029691:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && start + 2 < end)

029711:             state->operation = operation;
029712:             state->simple = simple;

029718: 
029719: // Each advance runs the stage machine to a child request or the finish; the
029720: // request helpers run the child off the dispatch loop and report whether it
029721: // completed, so a completed child re-enters the CHILD arm here as a
029722: // self-loop instead of resuming through a dispatch round trip.
029723: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
029724: {
029725:     bool stepping = true;
029726:     while (stepping)
029727:     {
029728:         stepping = c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_advance(builder);
029729:     }
029730: }
029731: 
029732: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_frame_fallback(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
029733: {
029734:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
029735:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
029736:     CIrLowerFrame* active = machine->frames + machine->frame_count - 1;
029737:     switch (active->kind)
029738:     {
029739:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PLACE:
029740:             c_ir_lower_place_step(builder, active);
029741:             return;
029742:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_VLA_INDEX_PLACE:
029743:             c_ir_lower_vla_index_place_step(builder, active);
029744:             return;
029745:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ATOMIC_PLACE:
029746:             c_ir_lower_atomic_place_step(builder, active);
029747:             return;
029748:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_VA_LIST_EXPRESSION:
029749:             c_ir_lower_va_list_expression_step(builder, active);
029750:             return;
029751:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_COMPOUND_LITERAL:
029752:             c_ir_lower_compound_literal_step(builder, active);
029753:             return;
029754:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_NESTED_COMPOUND_LITERAL:
029755:             c_ir_lower_nested_compound_literal_step(builder, active);
029756:             return;
029757:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PREPARE_CONTROL_EXPRESSIONS:
029758:             c_ir_prepare_control_expressions_step(builder, active);
029759:             return;
029760:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PREPARE_CALLS:
029761:             c_ir_prepare_calls_step(builder, active);
029762:             return;
029763:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_PREPARED_CALL:
029764:         {
029765:             CIrPreparedCallStepResult result = c_ir_emit_prepared_call_step(builder, active);
029766:             if (result != C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_SUSPENDED)
029767:             {
029768:                 c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, result == C_IR_PREPARED_CALL_STEP_FINISHED, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
029769:             }
029770:             return;
029771:         }
029772:         default:
029773:             break;
029774:     }
029775:     switch (active->kind)
029776:     {
029777:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION:
029778:             c_ir_lower_expression_step(builder);
029779:             return;
029780:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION_CORE:
029781:             c_ir_lower_expression_core_step(builder);
029782:             return;
029783:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_LOGICAL_VALUE:
029784:             c_ir_lower_logical_value_step(builder);
029785:             return;
029786:         case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_CONDITION:
029787:             c_ir_lower_condition_step(builder);
